Package aor.proj3t.daos.impl

Class SettingsDAOimpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.AbstractDAO<Settings,Long>
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.SettingsDAOimpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
BasicDAO<Settings,Long>, SettingsDAO
public class SettingsDAOimpl extends AbstractDAO<Settings,Long> implements SettingsDAO
Stateless EJB implementation of the SettingsDAO interface.

This class provides concrete implementation for managing application-wide configuration settings. It extends AbstractDAO to leverage common CRUD operations and implements specific business logic for configuration management and versioning support.

Key implementation features:

  • Named query usage for optimized latest settings retrieval
  • Safe handling of settings lookup with Optional return types
  • Support for configuration versioning and history
  • Efficient single-result queries with proper limit handling

    • getLatestSettings

      public Optional<Settings> getLatestSettings()
      Retrieves the most recent settings configuration.

      This method returns the latest version of application settings, which represents the current active configuration. If multiple settings records exist (for versioning purposes), this method returns the most recently created or updated one.

      Implementation uses the named query "Settings.getLatestSettings" for optimized retrieval of the most recent configuration. Uses result limit and safe Optional handling to ensure only one result is returned.

      Specified by:
      getLatestSettings in interface SettingsDAO
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the latest settings if found, or Optional.empty() if no settings exist in the system
